identity: Independent link from the catalogued paper to the authors’ repository.
analysis: Independently checked the 1,000 dataset rows: 1,000 unique IDs, all referenced images present, all three script keys on each row, and exactly one matching answer option per script. All three gold option positions agreed on every row. This verifies structural pairing; semantic equivalence of each translation and published model scores were not independently assessed.
os: Dataset inspection requires only a JSON reader. Running model-specific evaluation scripts needs their respective environments and, for hosted models, API access. OS compatibility not tested.
data: Images, three script versions of each question, answer options, labels and model outputs. A hosted evaluation can transmit the examples to its provider.

malware_check.method: Static scan of .py/.sh/.js/.ts/.ps1 files below 1 MB for eval, process launch and piped downloads. No downloaded code executed. Dependencies, model weights and release binaries have no antivirus verdict here.

data: Source documents, index files, queries, retrieved passages and generated outputs. Storage and compute follow the supplied configuration.
